pages.en:
Form No. 3
(C. 23000-1-36)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____

S.I, Special Branch No. 837
REPORT
Date March 15, 1937.

Subject (in full) Bank of Communications - 30th Anniversary Meeting.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by I. Boyau D.S.I.

Between 10.30 a.m. and 11.45 a.m. March 14, the
Bank of Communications held its 30th Anniversary meeting in
the New Asia Hotel, 422 Tiendong Road. (Hongkew District).
About 800 persons, including Dr. H.H. Kung, Minister of
Finance, Messrs Hsu Kai and Tseu Ling, Vice Ministers of
Finance, Mr. Pang Hsueh-pan, Vice Minister of Communications,
and General Yang Hu, Garrison Commander of Woosung-Shanghai
area, attended.

The meeting was followed by a dinner party and
entertainments in the form of theatrical performances, which
continued till midnight.

Observation duty was carried out by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken,
C.D.S. 94, C.D.S. 156 and C.D.C. 357. No untoward incident
occurred.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 15 MAR. 1937 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

表格第3号
(C. 23000-1-36)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 ____

S.I，特务科第837号
报告
日期：1937年3月15日。

事由（全称）交通银行——三十周年纪念大会。

呈报人：副督察长高延根 转呈人：I. Boyau 副督察长

1937年3月14日上午10时30分至11时45分之间，
交通银行在天潼路422号新亚酒店（虹口区）举行
三十周年纪念大会。约800人出席，其中包括财政部长孔祥熙博士，财政部次长徐堪和邹琳先生，交通部次长潘学斌先生，以及吴淞-上海地区卫戍司令杨虎将军。

会议随后举行了晚宴及戏剧表演形式的娱乐活动，
一直持续到午夜。

观察勤务由副督察长高延根、刑事侦缉警员94号、刑事侦缉警员156号及刑事侦缉巡长357号执行。未发生任何意外事件。

高延根
副督察长

侦探长（特务科）。

（印：特务科 / 1937年3月15日 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

Translation of a letter received from the
Bank of Communications, 14 The Bund, on
March 13,1937.

March 13,1937.

To the Shanghai Municipal Police.

Between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m. Sunday,
March 14, 1937, the Bank of Communications will
hold its 30th anniversary meeting in the New Asia
Hotel, North Szechuen Road. As several important
Government officials will attend this function, it
is requested that extra police be detailed for duty
in the vicinity of the Hotel for purpose of protection.

The Bank of Communications,
Head Office.

S.I.
〔此处转录不清〕
D S. S. Kao.
J.b. 13/3

1937年3月13日收到来自
外滩14号交通银行的信函译文。
---

1937年3月13日。

致上海公共租界工部局警务处。

1937年3月14日（星期日）上午10时至下午2时之间，
交通银行将在北四川路新亚酒店
举行三十周年纪念大会。鉴于数位政府要员将出席此次活动，
恳请调派额外警力在酒店附近执行勤务，以资保护。

交通银行
总行

S.I.
〔此处转录不清〕
D S. S. Kao.
J.b. 13/3

〔此处转录不清〕
